invariants: administrator global read is separate from ordinary sharing and is never inferred from a shared-patient write permission
administrator global read is fail-closed unless the caller is the sole active administrator and explicitly requests global_read with a bounded purpose
administrator global read never grants create, update, delete, upload, review, commit, void, withdraw, or delegated-upload authority
every cross-subject global read, original-file view or download, and export handoff creates an audit record without copying health values
cross-subject dashboard clipboard, CSV, and print handoff is limited to the already-loaded dashboard snapshot and fails closed before client output when the audit authorization is unavailable
browser preview reuses the retained original, allows only explicitly listed PDF and image MIME types, revokes the client object URL on close, and audits only after source and file validation
cross-subject AI transfer and complete server-archive batch export remain unavailable through the dashboard handoff capability
ordinary members cannot discover or invoke administrator global-read or member-reset capabilities
member reset never accepts an administrator target and never reactivates a deactivated account
the server generates the temporary password, returns it once with no-store caching, stores only a formal password hash, and never writes the credential to logs or audit metadata
member reset advances auth_version, revokes old sessions, forces a password change, expires after 60 minutes, and can be used for at most one login
wrong target confirmation, unsupported authentication method, multiple active administrators, or any persistence failure causes a full rollback
